crop.notes: Whole 'It's All the Talk' New Orleans dispatch, headline to end.

ocr.notes: Readable; a few garbled words (Joe Coburn rendered as 'Joe pangs ME'), Allen's quotes correct apart from small errors.

title.suggested: Tom Allen in New Orleans backs Kilrain

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported from New Orleans, on the eve of the Sullivan-Kilrain fight, that Tom Allen was among the pugilists at the St. Charles Hotel. He said he was for Kilrain but thought him too fat.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Republic, Monday Morning, July 8, 1889. Dispatch dated New Orleans, July 7.

facts.fact: Allen was in New Orleans for the Sullivan-Kilrain championship fight, among the pugilists gathered at the St. Charles Hotel
places: St. Charles Hotel, New Orleans, Louisiana

facts.fact: Asked about the Sullivan-Kilrain fight, Allen said he backed Kilrain
Allen said Kilrain's condition was good but he was too fat
facts.quote: It is good, but I would like him better if he were not so fat. I like to see the cheek-bones sticking out.

notes: Same trip and topic as 771 (Post-Dispatch, same day).
